title: Connecting Clauses: Because and So
description: Combine clauses to explain reasons and results using because and so in compound sentences.

items.sentence: I stayed at home because it was raining heavily.
alternatives: Because it was raining heavily I stayed at home.
items.translation: Fiquei em casa porque estava chovendo muito.

items.sentence: He was exhausted so he went to sleep early.
items.translation: Ele estava exausto, então foi dormir cedo.

items.sentence: She studied hard so she passed the exam.
items.translation: Ela estudou muito, então passou no exame.

items.sentence: We cooked dinner at home because restaurants were closed.
alternatives: Because restaurants were closed we cooked dinner at home.
items.translation: Cozinhamos o jantar em casa porque os restaurantes estavam fechados.

items.sentence: The traffic was terrible so we arrived late.
items.translation: O trânsito estava terrível, então chegamos atrasados.

items.sentence: I love reading because it helps me relax.
items.translation: Adoro ler porque me ajuda a relaxar.

items.sentence: She forgot her umbrella so she got wet.
items.translation: Ela esqueceu o guarda-chuva, então se molhou.
